data.one_liner: Production-level logger utility for Dart and Flutter with strategy-based configuration.
data.what_it_does: Surf Logger provides a tool to configure logging within your application using custom log strategies. It separates configuration methods from usage methods via the LogWriter interface to prevent accidental changes during injection.
use_when: You need to route logs to different destinations (console, files, Firebase, Sentry) based on app flavors or environments.
You want to separate logger configuration from the interface used for writing logs.
avoid_when: You want an out-of-the-box logger with built-in pretty console formatting without writing custom strategies.
strengths: Strategy pattern makes it flexible to send logs to any backend or storage.
Not a singleton starting from version 2.0.0, which helps with testing and multiple scopes.
Separates logger configuration from the LogWriter interface.
weaknesses: Requires writing custom strategies for specific logging destinations.
Dependency on external loggers has been removed, meaning you must define how logging is handled.
data.setup_notes: Add surf_logger to dependencies and configure log strategies.
